raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely assumed that “Rostov” referred to Rostov-on-Don and proceeded on that basis, ignoring historical/contextual clues that John the Hairy (a 16th-century Orthodox saint) is associated with Rostov the Great (Rostov Veliky) in Yaroslavl Oblast. This unverified disambiguation (and overlooking that Rostov-on-Don was founded later) led the workflow toward the wrong territorial entity.
